title: "Stock Data Display"
author: "Nayeli Cruz"
output:
  word_document: default
  html_document: default
  pdf_document: default
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("stock_functions.R")
```

## Display Functions

```{r display_functions}
show_table <- function(df, rows = 5) {
  knitr::kable(tail(df, rows), row.names = FALSE, digits = 2)
}

plot_price <- function(df, symbol, n = 20) {
  ma <- TTR::SMA(df$Close, n = min(n, nrow(df)))
  plot(df$Date, df$Close, type = "l", xlab = "Date", ylab = "Close price",
       main = paste(symbol, "closing price"))
  lines(df$Date, ma, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Close", paste(n, "day moving average")),
         col = c("black", "blue"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
}

plot_volume <- function(df, symbol) {
  plot(df$Date, df$Volume, type = "h", xlab = "Date", ylab = "Volume",
       main = paste(symbol, "trading volume"))
}
```

## Load Data

```{r load_data}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
if (length(stocks) == 0) stop("No stock data loaded. Check your internet connection.")
names(stocks)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r statistics}
stats <- lapply(stocks, calculate_statistics)
knitr::kable(summary_table(stats), digits = 2)
```

## Stock Details

```{r details, results = "asis", fig.height = 4}
for (s in names(stocks)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n")
  print(show_table(stocks[[s]]))
  cat("\n\n")
  plot_price(stocks[[s]], s)
  plot_volume(stocks[[s]], s)
}
```
